responsibility: Implements statement-level type checking for Rust HIR. It dispatches expression statements, let statements, item statements, extern blocks, and type paths to the appropriate lower-level resolvers, performs let-binding initialization versus annotation coercion and pattern typing, and returns the TyTy type associated with each statement form, usually unit for non-value statements.
same_name_distinction: Implements statement dispatch: it routes statements to expression, pattern, type, item, impl-item, and extern-item resolvers and performs let-statement coercion and pattern typing. By contrast, rust-hir-type-check-stmt.h only defines the TypeCheckStmt visitor surface.
